title: Cleanup Preview Deployments
description: Remove old preview deployments from the target gh-pages branch and update the associated PR comments.

remote.description: URL for the git remote containing the preview deployments. Defaults to the project's origin remote.

remoteName.description: Name of the remote to push to

baseBranch.description: Branch that hosts the deployed site

pathPrefix.description: Top-level directory on the deployment branch that contains per-PR subdirectories

maxAgeDays.description: Delete preview directories whose most recent commit is older than this many days

all.description: Delete every preview directory regardless of age

updatePrComments.description: Update the preview deployment PR comment for each cleaned directory

commitMessage.description: Commit message used for the cleanup commit
commitMessage.default: chore: cleanup old preview deployments [skip ci]

user.description: User information used when authoring the cleanup commit
